properties.site-address: Hospital land at Dean Street, Hexham
properties.notes: Draft Local Plan housing site allocation - reflected in emerging draft Hexham Neighbourhood Plan. Saved Tynedale Local Plan allocation for residential development. Two pre-apps have been submitted for consideration in 2018 . First for conversion of and extension of existing buildings to 33 apartments on the western part of the site. Second for 48 retirement apartments on the eastern section.. Hospital land and buildings within existing urban environment. Extensive site potentially offering opportunity for redevelopment through conversion and/or new building development. https://www.northumberland.gov.uk/NorthumberlandCountyCouncil/media/Planning-and-Building/planning%20policy/Studies%20and%20Evidence%20Reports/Housing%20Studies/1.%20SHLAA/Appendix-G-SHLAA-Sites-Summary-Assessment-Schedule.pdf
